I am an **Assistant Professor** in the [Department of Mathematics and Statistics](https://www.uvic.ca/science/math-statistics/) at the **University of Victoria**.

My research develops statistical methods for complex data including functions, matrices, and tensors, with a focus on Bayesian methods for neuroimaging and precision medicine. Learn more on my [Research](research.qmd) and [Publications](publications.qmd) pages.

Before joining UVic, I was a postdoctoral researcher in [Biostatistics](https://med.nyu.edu/departments-institutes/population-health/divisions-sections-centers/biostatistics) at the [NYU Grossman School of Medicine](https://med.nyu.edu), working with [Thaddeus Tarpey](https://med.nyu.edu/faculty/thaddeus-tarpey) and [Hyung G. Park](https://med.nyu.edu/faculty/hyung-g-park).
I received my Ph.D. in [Statistics](https://www.stat.ubc.ca) from the [University of British Columbia](https://www.ubc.ca), supervised by [Matías Salibián-Barrera](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/users/matias-salibian-barrera).
